personality_one_liner: A high-performance, command-center athletic experience that feels tactile, responsive, and relentlessly focused on the workout.

spacing.rule: Use tight modular spacing to maximize screen real estate. Use generous bottom padding for scroll views to clear the sticky CTAs and tab bar.

do's: Use heavy tint (75%+ opacity #121214) underneath the blur for bottom tab bar and sticky headers to guarantee readability.
dont's: Do not use glass for list items or data cards; rely on solid surfaceSecondary and tonal dividers.

screens.name: Auth (Sign Up / Login)
screens.purpose: Frictionless entry using Email or Google.
screens.layout: Minimalist layout with a full-bleed dark gym image overlaid by a heavy top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to #121214). Large Barlow Condensed title. Social login buttons (Google, Apple) as wide pill buttons with brandTertiary background. Email input fields at the bottom.

screens.name: Home / Upcoming Events
screens.purpose: A dashboard combining the user's next booked class and a feed of upcoming gym events.

states.empty: Illustration of a gym mat with 'No upcoming classes. Ready to sweat?' and a 'View Timetable' CTA.
states.error: Error message with 'Tap to reload' CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky header with user avatar. Top section features a large 'Next Class' hero card (glass over photo) with a countdown timer. Below, a horizontal scroll of 'Upcoming Events' using surfaceSecondary cards. Section titles in uppercase Barlow Condensed.

screens.name: Class Timetable
screens.purpose: Easily scan and discover classes by day, time, and type.

states.empty: Message stating 'No classes scheduled for this day.'

screens.layout: Top edge has a sticky horizontal week/day selector. Content is a vertical list: left column shows time, right column contains heavy surfaceSecondary cards for classes (Yoga, HIIT, Dance) with intensity indicator pills (brandTertiary). Thumb-friendly layout.

screens.name: Class Booking Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into class info and confirm booking.
screens.layout: Full-bleed image at the top (with a dark gradient scrim). Class title overlay. Below the fold: trainer info, description, spots left. Sticky absolute-positioned 'Book Class' primary CTA button at the bottom of the screen above the safe area.

screens.name: Payment Flow (Stripe/PayPal)
screens.purpose: Handle transactions for paid classes or memberships securely.

states.error: Payment failed state with clear reason and 'Try Another Method' button.

screens.layout: Presented as a Gorhom bottom sheet. Breakdown of costs. Options to select PayPal or Credit Card (Stripe). Large high-contrast total amount. Sticky 'Pay Now' CTA in brandPrimary.

screens.name: Notifications
screens.purpose: In-app feed of all push and email alerts.

states.empty: Bell icon with 'You're all caught up.'

screens.layout: Simple list using divider separations (not cards). Unread items have a brandPrimary dot indicator. Minimalist layout emphasizing the text.

screens.name: User Profile
screens.purpose: Manage membership, payment methods, and app settings.
screens.layout: Header shows user stats (classes attended). Vertical list of settings rows using surfaceSecondary with Phosphor icons inside tinted brandTertiary squares.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility DARK guidelines. Do not use pure black (#000000) for backgrounds; use #121214. Do not use blue or purple anywhere.
Implement the 'Barlow Condensed' font for titles and large numbers, and 'DM Sans' for body text using expo-font.
The primary highlight color is Volt/Neon Lime (#CCFF00). Use it sparingly for primary CTAs, active states, and progress bars. Do NOT use it for large surface areas.
For the Class Timetable, ensure the horizontal day selector is sticky at the top, allowing the schedule list below to scroll cleanly underneath.
Any hero images or class cover images MUST have a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (from transparent to #121214 at ≥75% opacity) overlaid before placing text to guarantee WCAG contrast.
Place the 'Book Class' and 'Pay Now' buttons inside a sticky container anchored to the bottom of the screen, just above the safe area, avoiding the scroll view.
